notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where the relic "Lovely Apple" didn't function correctly when being caught up by Mama.
- Fixed a bug where, while possessing the relic "Basics of Magic", MP would stop decreasing after reaching its maximum.
- Fixed a bug where MP was consumed twice when doubled via double tap.

notes.title: var1.05: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Fixed an issue where skills could be placed in the condition slot by following specific steps.
- Fixed a bug where battle predictions would break if a shop event triggered while a skill was selected.
- Fixed display issues when applying the special condition "Enchanted Sword" to skills like "Authority" and "Alchemy" that involve Energy, MP, and Research.
- Fixed an issue where the relic "Basics of Magic" did not properly restore MP.
- Fixed an issue where losing a battle immediately after gaining Gold would cause the Gold to not roll back correctly.
- Fixed a bug where the effect of the relic "Apple Pie" was displayed even when not in possession.
- Fixed a bug where the relic "Twisted Heart" would show its effect even for enemy healing actions.
- Fixed a bug where Strength values of four digits or more would not display correctly.
- Changed skills "Fiery Body" and "Fire Fist" so that self-inflicted damage no longer causes Burn on the user.

[b]Individual Response[/b]

- "Do we really need the 40-skill-per-turn limit?"
→ I want to avoid interfering with the combos players come up with as much as possible, but without a usage limit, predictions would continue infinitely due to how the system works. Sorry about that... 40 is a number chosen to strike a balance between the thrill of game-breaking loops and a manageable prediction length.

notes.title: ver1.04: Bug Fixes and Skill Adjustments
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Fixed a bug where the skill “Philosopher's Stone” was not affected by the special condition “Limit Break.”  
- Changed the skill “Switching” so that it no longer progresses the count of “Judgment.”  
- Fixed a bug where using the skill “Switching” on the Area 2 boss “Houseki” would not properly grant a shield.  
- Fixed a bug where, if you lost immediately after using “Help Me, Shop-chan!”, your gold would not roll back properly.  
- Fixed a bug where Muramasa's energy cost would decrease even when using an attack skill with the “Reverse” condition.  
- Fixed a bug where applying the “Reverse” condition to a damaging skill while holding the relic “Summoner” would not properly grant a shield.  
- Changed the timing description of the Burn debuff to "after the end of the turn."  
- Fixed a bug where rewinding the battle at the moment you’re caught by Mama would leave the top of the screen stuck white.  
- Fixed a bug where you could upgrade even without enough gold if you selected upgrade first and then purchased an item in the shop.  
- Fixed a bug that allowed inserting conditions into skill slots through special steps. (Sorry for the delay!)  
- Fixed a bug where potions were not removed if you switched Plans on the post-battle result screen after using one.  
- Fixed a bug where rapidly pressing the battle start button in certain situations could cause it to disappear.
- Fixed a bug where the tutorial about the skill usage limit was not showing up in the list.

[b]Balance Adjustments[/b]

- Changed the energy cost of the skill “Switching” from 3 to 1. After upgrade, it now also grants energy equal to 10% of the shield you had.  
- Increased the healing amount of the “Healing Potion” from 40 to 120.  
- Increased the immunity gain from the “Immunity Potion” from 2 to 8.  
- Reduced the energy cost of the skill “Fiery Body” from 3 to 2.  
- Added a summon limit of 300 to the skill “Endless Zaplet” to reduce performance load.  
- Split the conditions “More Shield Than Enemy” and “More Shield Than Self” into separate ones.  
- Changed the energy reference timing of “Two Sides” and “Two Alternatives” to occur before skill activation for better management.

[b]Thank you all so much for the many reports and suggestions![/b]

Thanks to your feedback, I'm able to push better updates forward!  
Below are individual responses to some issues I felt needed particular attention.  

- “Do Kemo (the white one) and the Mage have different Benchmark Turn?”  
  → In the early English version, the bonus selection text that says “gain fewer Benchmark Turn in exchange for a boss relic” did not display correctly. This is now fixed!

- “Judgment doesn't progress when using the relic 'Power of Money'?”  
  → Most non-skill damage sources are set not to trigger extra effects to prevent infinite loops. (The relic “Kunai” is a rare exception and does trigger effects.)

- “With Little Magic, the Plasma boost increases by 2 instead of 1?”  
  → You get 1 boost from using a skill and another from Little Magic’s effect, for a total of 2!

- “Did the hidden boss 'Dragon Knight' disappear?”  
  → In earlier versions, it appeared on Hard or higher, but now it's limited to difficulty “?Level 5” only.

- “No-damage bonus doesn’t account for increased max HP?”  
  → This is intentional! If your HP hasn’t dropped between the start and end of battle, you get the no-damage bonus.

- “If I finish an enemy with Cost Bomb, the skill’s effect doesn’t activate.”  
  → In this game, battles end immediately when an enemy’s HP hits 0. Since Cost Bomb triggers before the skill activates, it behaves this way.
